import gdb, json
uaddr = None
dram = None
captures = 0

def discover():
    global dram
    rb = gdb.parse_and_eval('ram_list.blocks.lh_first')
    while int(rb):
        item = rb.dereference()
        name = item['idstr'].string()
        if name == 'esp32s3.dram':
            dram = int(item['host'])
            gdb.write('DRAM_HOST '+hex(dram)+'\n')
            return
        rb = item['next']['le_next']
    raise RuntimeError('Actual esp32s3.dram RAM block not found')

def snap(label, u):
    global captures
    if dram is None: discover()
    soc = u['parent']['soc_reset'].cast(gdb.lookup_type('Esp32s3SocState').pointer()).dereference()
    port = int(gdb.parse_and_eval('*(unsigned char *)'+hex(dram+0x6f14c)))
    pc = int(soc['cpu'][0]['env']['pc'])
    row = {'event':label,'guest_pc':hex(pc),'selected_port':port,'raw':hex(int(u['regs'][1])),'masked':hex(int(u['regs'][2])),'ena':hex(int(u['regs'][3])),'fifo':str(u['parent']['rx_fifo']),'rx_rptr':int(u['rx_rptr']),'rx_wptr':int(u['rx_wptr']),'console':str(u['console_rx']),'console_active':bool(u['console_active']),'console_step':int(u['console_step']),'console_byte':int(u['console_byte']),'console_origin':int(u['console_origin']),'console_edge_ns':int(u['console_edge_ns']),'gate':bool(u['gate']),'held_reset':bool(u['held_reset']),'rx_full_threshold':int(u['core'][9])&1023,'irq_map':int(soc['intmatrix']['irq_map'][0][27]),'source_level':bool(soc['intmatrix']['input_level'][27])}
    gdb.write(json.dumps(row)+'\n')
    captures += 1

class Write(gdb.Breakpoint):
    def stop(self):
        global uaddr
        u = gdb.parse_and_eval('(ESP32S3UARTState *)opaque').dereference()
        addr = int(gdb.parse_and_eval('addr'))
        if int(u['index'])==0 and addr in (0x10,0x0c):
            uaddr=int(u.address)
            snap('write-before '+hex(addr)+' value='+hex(int(gdb.parse_and_eval('value'))),u)
        return False

class Updated(gdb.Breakpoint):
    def stop(self):
        u = gdb.parse_and_eval('s').dereference()
        if int(u['index'])==0 and int(u['parent']['rx_fifo']['num'])>0:
            snap('update-before-irq',u)
        return False
